description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aluthgama Bogamuwa D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/55041)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, and cadastral details. It involves calling for claims to property of deceased individuals and the registration process under the Registration of Title Act, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as defined by land and property-related matters including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
